system.description:
The independent circle of Mournas, outside the Cabal, and the hedge-druids of Opal's gardens: the wild that lives in walls, gutters and gardens.

  • Urban Swarm: in a town or city, one creature of your choice you hit with a spell each round has Disadvantage on its next attack roll, as the rats and pigeons swarm it. Advantage on Dismiss Woodland Creatures checks in or under a city.
    • 9th level: the swarm also comes outside towns, wherever rats, birds or insects can reach.
  • City's Wild: Advantage on checks to find shelter, safe passage or allies in a city through its wild things: the rats in the walls, the moss on the stones, the gardens between buildings.
